text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Please, reach... Reach them—

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Way to go, Fine Motion~~!! That was the 
greatest run ever!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: "Ugh... Uuu...! *sniff*!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Are you crying!? Why!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"B-Because... Fine Motion looked so happy, 
and like she was having so much fun...!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
To me, it looked like it was shining, man! 
It was like it told me to burn it into my 
memory no matter what... Uwooooh!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motiooon!! I'll never forget today's 
race!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: "Fine-san...! U-Um..."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Rob Roy-chan!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Hyawa!?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
You know, I'm just so happy right now. I 
truly feel like my feelings reached 
someone's heart!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
And besides, the race was incredible too! 
Everyone was buzzing with excitement, and 
then—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh? What is it, what is it? Did I say 
something funny?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, w-well... I just thought you were like 
someone straight out of a storybook.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: A story?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"I've always thought so. Fine-san, you're 
like such a charming main character."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Heart-pounding, restless, on the edge of 
your seat. The kind of story that leaves 
you smiling when you finish it...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Her running today was yet another one 
that makes you want to recount its tale 
forever..."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
If I could be among them again, that would 
make me so happy...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Stories, huh?

"Let's leave behind an impact named Fine 
Motion."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...I see. It had already begun a long time 
ago, hadn't it?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
You don't need to feel lonely. Because my 
running is—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Because it will live on in everyone's 
hearts."

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Man, that was a great race. Fine Motion 
looked like she completely blew away all 
her doubts!"

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Right?! That felt so good to watch~. I 
can't wait for the upcoming races!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Ah-ah, shit. I ain't feelin' even a 
millimeter good over here.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
In the end, you didn't overturn fate 
either, huh? ...As for me...

When I went to meet Fine Motion in the 
waiting room... she wore a bright, radiant 
smile.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"There can only be one, right? Today's 
race, of course!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"When I screamed, 'Don't you forget me~!', 
it felt better than any run I've ever 
had!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'm not sure if it left an impact on 
everyone else yet... But it was definitely 
carved deep into my heart!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"I want to race like this even more! I 
mean, we still have time, right?"

Considering her track record, I'd like to 
keep producing results in GⅠ races like 
this, but—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh! I just got a great idea.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I have a favor to ask. I want to run 
somewhere I haven't been before!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
If I travel far and wide, as many people 
as possible will remember my races, won't 
they?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
So that my feelings may sprout within the 
hearts of so many people...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"To do that, I've gotta go out there 
myself!"

I understand what she wants. But with her 
current ability, we also have to consider 
the caliber of the other runners. Choosing 
the right race is proving quite 
difficult...
choice_data_list:
By the way, is there anywhere you want to 
go?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ah, ramen!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
You know about regional ramen, right? 
Shakur made an app for me so I can take 
notes whenever there's a shop I want to 
visit.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
In the end, I've barely been to most of 
them, though. The ones I've visited most 
are... Fukuoka, Hokkaido—

Speaking of Hokkaido, that reminds me. 
Word is that a formidable competitor will 
be entering a race in Sapporo. It should 
make for a fine memory for her.
choice_data_list: Then, how about the Sapporo Kinen?
Then, how about the Sapporo Kinen?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Sapporo ramen! Of course I'd love to 
go eat some♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
“Not that that's all, of course! I want 
everyone in Hokkaido to see how I run.”

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Off to Sapporo♪

And so, the next target race was decided: 
the Sapporo Kinen!
